name: set_secret
description: Store a credential value in this tenant's vault so user-tools can read it at runtime. Use when a tool's `_meta.allowed_secrets` references a NAME the user hasn't pasted a value for yet — typically the first time the user runs an api_key or oauth2 tool. Example flow: user says 'use the UPS API', Diana drafts a spec with `authentication.method = oauth2_client_credentials` and `client_id_secret = UPS_CLIENT_ID` / `client_secret_secret = UPS_CLIENT_SECRET`, after the tool is built the user is prompted to set both secrets via this tool. The value is stored in noted's per-tenant vault and never echoed back; the frontend renders the `value` input MASKED. Returns a one-line confirmation that does NOT include the value.

name.description: UPPERCASE secret identifier the tool's `allowed_secrets` references (e.g. NEWSAPI_KEY, UPS_CLIENT_ID). Letters/digits/underscores, starts with a letter, max 64 chars.

value.description: The secret VALUE the user pastes. The frontend MUST render this input masked. Never logged, never echoed in the tool's response.

tenant_id.description: Tenant scope; omit unless the deployment supports multi-tenant. Defaults to 'default'.
